title: Origin story: Dracula
description: Count Dracula of Stoker's 1897 novel was a Transylvanian nobleman, a centuries-old vampire who purchased an English estate and sailed to Whitby in a coffin of earth. Scholar, soldier, and predator, he was hunted by Van Helsing's band and destroyed at his castle gates — the novel told entirely in letters and journals.
